Title: Sanjay's Day

Cast

1. Sanjay - 35 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Kavita - 60 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Sanjay stands in the living room. Kavita stands near him.]

Kavita: "What lovely weather!"

[Sanjay coughs in the thick smoke and crawls to the door.]

Sanjay: "Oh wow!"

[Sanjay throws a bucket of water on the fire.]

Kavita: "I really enjoyed today."
